title: MCP Toolbox v1.18 and debug-stack gotchas
what: Google MCP Toolbox for Databases v1.18.0: flag `--config` (no `--tools-file`), MCP stdio via `--stdio`, `invoke <tool> '<json>'` prints a JSON array only with `--log-level ERROR`. `${ENV}` substitution is textual before YAML parsing, so it applies inside comments and an unset var fails the load. Debug anvil.exe overflowed the 1 MiB Windows main stack once the clap tree grew.
why: Generated tools.yaml must never contain `${` in comments; relative sqlite paths resolve against cwd so Toolbox always runs from the repo root; the CLI now runs on a 16 MiB thread.
learned: Verify Toolbox behavior with the real binary before relying on docs; keep main.rs stack thread if adding subcommands.
author: reactive-end
